title: SO-A-06 Artifact registry: every material artifact linked to its requirement, revisions, scope version and verification state, with history, comparison and previews served within the workspace grants, and the files kept in the user's workspace
request: Build layer of the Scope One programme, adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026 (fold id SO-A-06) and validated against memev main at d1c65ef. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository; they are cited by id only. Implements the design record SO-1.09 (Artefacts: version history, comparison and previews that show verification state) (contracts/scope-one/specs). The decision record cites this contract by id and keeps only the gaps this one does not cover. Builds on signed vault contracts: SO-02-B†, SO-05-C†, SO-05-D†, SO-C-C†, SO-O-A†. Memev contracts that land first: SO-A-04, SO-1.01. Source in the fold: #222 recommendation 9 (inspectable and attributable artefacts). Settled decisions this contract follows (owner decision 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md): topology is local-first and the cloud is only a relay and a backup; every supported provider stands on equal footing and no work or tier depends on one; crdt-merge is reached only through the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs (docs/EXTENSION-POINTS.md) and this contract adds no merge engine to the core; tiers follow docs/PRICING.md (Free core, Personal for up to 3 computers with no per-computer add-on, higher tiers by contacting us) with no Personal trial; the git backup keeps running every few minutes (sync.interval_min). Memory authority: ADR 7 (memory and project-state authority) is proposed in PR #325 and is not decided here; this contract cites it and the local-first decision, and keeps one store under the vault with no second database. Provenance: adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026. Changes: (1) converted from the vault task format to the memev spec format (named tests run as red-green checks on the own test file of the contract; inline regular expression flags became the flags key; hygiene and decision verifiers became commands or doc checks). (2) removed fold-only fields and the owner-decision marker field, reworded the stop rule that named a patent, and made the text pass the leak scan. (3) Review addition: a preview of Markdown or diagram source is rendered escaped, so an artifact cannot run script in the daemon page (one new criterion).

tasks.description: The addendum (recommendation 9) requires artifacts to be inspectable and attributable: linked to their origin, versioned, distinguished as draft, reviewed or accepted, previewed with their verification state, and never copied into an opaque authoritative store. SO-05-D binds evidence to artifact hashes and SO-C-C AC03 renders deliverables with version, provenance and validation status; previews reach workspace files only through the grant check of SO-O-A AC02. This contract adds the registry those read from. The code's spelling, artifact, is used throughout.

criteria.statement: an artifact record links to its requirement, deliverable or work package, its creation and revision events, the scope and plan version and the verification status, and carries the state draft, reviewed or accepted; the states change only by events; the Deliverables view of SO-C-C AC03 reads the registry

stop_rules: Stop and post BLOCKED when a criterion cannot pass without weakening a test, skipping a test or relaxing an assertion.
Stop and ask when the work would name a client product, a person, a server or a seat in repository text; the client names live in docs/CLIENTS.md only.
Stop when the work would add a runtime dependency, a model call, a network call at install or start, a second store for project state, or any reporting that is not opt-in and off by default.
Stop when the work would move convergence logic into the core, vendor the engine, or add a merge engine beside the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs.
If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.
